_comment: Third-party corpora for the detection-accuracy lanes. NOTHING listed here is vendored: fetch_corpora.py fetches each into its gitignored dest dir. 'pin' is the commit the numbers in SSOT.md were measured on; null means 'not pinned yet -- the first fetch records the HEAD it got and blind_recall_results.json reports it'. Sizes/file counts of EVTX-to-MITRE-Attack are deliberately absent until the first real fetch measures them.

splunk-attack-data.label_source: datasets/attack_techniques/**/<scenario>.yml 'mitre_technique' list (dataset author); the technique directory name is a recorded cross-check and the only label for old-style YAMLs that carry a 'dataset:' URL list.
splunk-attack-data.lfs_note: Data files (*.log, *.json, *.ndjson) are git-lfs objects. The checkout runs with GIT_LFS_SKIP_SMUDGE=1 (pointers only); only the files named by the pre-registered selection predicate are pulled. A full pull is > 9 GB and is never done.

selection.predicate: scenarios whose YAML source is XmlWinEventLog:* and whose label shares a parent technique with an enterprise-ATT&CK rule in contracts/rules; per parent technique the N smallest scenarios (known-size LFS pointers first, then absent files whose size is unknown) by total declared LFS size, tie-break dataset_id ascending. Uses only dataset metadata and rule families, never outcomes.

evtx-to-mitre.label_source: directory layout TAxxxx-<Tactic>/Txxxx[.yyy|.xxx]-<name>/<file>.evtx (dataset author). '.xxx' is a family-level placeholder: the sub-technique is never invented. Top-level non-technique folders (e.g. Antivirus, EVTX_full_APT_attack_steps) are UNLABELLED.
evtx-to-mitre.licence_note: GitHub API reports CC0-1.0; the raw /master/LICENSE path returned 404 when the design was written. Confirm the licence file on first fetch.

evtx-attack-samples.label_source: tactic folder only (technique ids appear in 3 of 278 file names); NOT used by blind_recall.py (no technique-level label).
evtx-attack-samples.licence_note: GPL-3.0 into an Apache-2.0 repo: fetch-on-demand only, never committed anywhere.
